question: Find the value of {3sqrt2over sqrt6+sqrt3 }-{4sqrt3over sqrt6+sqrt2}-{6over sqrt 8-sqrt12}.
solution:
**Given:**

Find the value of: (3√2 / (√6 + √3)) - (4√3 / (√6 + √2)) - (6 / (√8 - √12)).

**Formula used:**

Rationalize the denominator using the formula: a / (b + c) = a(b - c) / (b² - c²).

**Calculation:**

First term: (3√2 / (√6 + √3))

⇒ Rationalize: (3√2 × (√6 - √3)) / ((√6 + √3)(√6 - √3))

⇒ (3√2(√6 - √3)) / (6 - 3) = √2(√6 - √3)

⇒ √12 - √6 = 2√3 - √6&l
